title: Homilies on Numbers, Homilia XV
blurb: Origen’s Homilia XV on Numbers (Rufinus’s Latin). Complete on this page: §§1–3.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Homilia XV on Numbers — no previous public-domain English (ANF lacks these homilies; Scheck FOTC is copyrighted and was not used as wording). This page is Homilia XV §§1–3 (closeout). The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Baehrens, Origenes Werke VII (GCS 30, 1921), Rufinus’s Latin of Homilia XV. Scheck FOTC was not used as wording. This page is Homilia XV §§1–3 (closeout).
